vietnamese.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
examples: Dùng find-skills cho tác vụ của tôi; giải thích kết quả bằng tiếng Việt.

notes: English SKILL.md and downloaded source files are byte-identical to the pinned GitHub commit.
No upstream scripts were executed. Compatibility is static only; runtime and provider acceptance remain untested.
